sections.title: Photos you upload — secure processing
sections.body:
snapfeed.help is a virtual try-on and product imagery service. To create results, you may upload photos of garments and people. We treat these uploads as sensitive user content and process them only as needed to deliver the feature you request.

• Purpose limitation: uploaded photos are used to run AI generation (and related quality/safety checks), store results in your gallery when applicable, and provide support if you contact us about a specific job.
• Access controls: access to uploaded and generated images is limited to systems and personnel needed to operate, secure, and support the service.
• Transmission & storage: photos are transmitted over encrypted connections (HTTPS/TLS) and stored with our infrastructure providers under access-restricted accounts.
• No sale of photos: we do not sell your uploaded photos, and we do not use them for advertising or unrelated third-party marketing.
• Subprocessors: to generate try-on and related imagery, necessary image/prompt data is sent to AI and hosting subprocessors listed below, solely to perform the requested processing.
• Retention: you may delete gallery items where the product allows; account deletion and support requests for deletion of associated uploads are handled as described in “Retention” and “Your privacy rights.” Backup copies may persist for a limited period.
• Your responsibility: only upload photos you have the right to use (including consent/model releases where required).

sections.title: Payments and Merchant of Record
sections.body: Lemon Squeezy, Inc. is the official Merchant of Record for paid credit packs sold through snapfeed.help. When you checkout, Lemon Squeezy processes your payment and may collect billing details, tax information, and related transaction data under Lemon Squeezy’s privacy policy. We receive confirmation of purchase and the information needed to credit your account; we do not store full payment card numbers on snapfeed.help servers.

sections.title: AI processing and subprocessors
sections.body:
To generate results, we send necessary image/prompt data to subprocessors, which may include:
• Supabase (authentication, database, storage)
• OpenAI (prompt assistance / image-related AI)
• Replicate (image generation models)
• FASHN (virtual try-on processing)
• Lemon Squeezy (Merchant of Record / payments)
• Hosting providers for our frontend/backend
These providers process data on our instructions (or, for Lemon Squeezy, as independent Merchant of Record for payment data) to deliver the service.

sections.title: Guest usage
sections.body: If you use the service without signing in, we store a fingerprint hash and may use IP address solely to enforce free generation limits. This guest data is not sold and is not used for advertising profiling.

sections.title: Cookies and similar technologies
sections.body: We use essential cookies/local storage for authentication session state, language, consent choice, and guest credit limits. See our Cookie Policy for details. Analytics or advertising cookies will only be used according to your consent choice once enabled.

sections.title: Retention
sections.body: We keep account and credit records while your account is active and as needed for legal, tax, and fraud-prevention purposes. Uploaded and generated gallery images are kept until you delete them or your account is deleted, subject to backup retention windows. Guest fingerprint/IP limit data is retained only as long as needed to enforce abuse controls.

sections.title: Security
sections.body: We use reasonable administrative and technical safeguards appropriate to an image-processing SaaS, including encrypted transit, access-restricted storage, and least-privilege practices for production systems. No method of transmission or storage is 100% secure. If you believe your account or uploads have been compromised, contact us immediately.

sections.title: Your privacy rights (including CCPA/CPRA)
sections.body:
Depending on your location (including California), you may have rights to:
• Know/access the personal information we hold about you
• Delete personal information
• Correct inaccurate information
• Opt out of “sale” or “sharing” of personal information for cross-context behavioral advertising
• Non-discrimination for exercising privacy rights

We do not sell personal information for money. If we use advertising pixels in the future, we will treat relevant sharing as subject to opt-out and honor your Cookie/consent choices and any “Do Not Sell or Share” request sent to our support email.

To exercise rights, email us with the subject “Privacy Request” and enough detail to verify your account (usually the Google email on the account).

sections.title: Children’s privacy
sections.body: snapfeed.help is not directed to children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. If you believe a child provided data, contact us and we will take appropriate steps to delete it.

sections.title: International users
sections.body: We are based in the United States. If you access the service from other countries, your information may be processed in the U.S. and other countries where our providers operate.

sections.title: Changes
sections.body: We may update this Privacy Policy periodically. The “Last updated” date will change when we do.
